scores.tell: Chair legs and arms have many sharp white specular hot spots and a glossy plastic sheen. Shadows are gentle, but the cast shadow on the floor is soft and generic.
Soft broad form turn, with a gentle core shadow under the roof and a grounded contact shadow. Slightly flat on the lower hull.
The cauldron is dark and heavily modeled, with moody gradients and scratch marks. The ground has a realistic, texture-heavy feel, and the glow from the fire is well rendered but too realistic.

The jellyfish is glowing and translucent, with airbrushed gradients and no solid core shadow. It has no cast shadow because it floats, and the soft sheen across the bell is more digital than the real cards.
Beach ball has broad soft highlights, a clear core shadow and a soft cast shadow on the sand. Close to the real cards, with slightly strong glossy spots on the red panel.
A smooth blob with soft light and warm rim light. The form turn is gentle and clean, but the shading is somewhat airbrushed, and there is no cast shadow.
Light is consistent and the form turn is smooth, with a soft shadow in the water. The thatch has some texture-driven shading, and the shadow depth is a little low.
Soft broad sheen, deep warm core shadow on the lower edge, and a soft contact shadow. Matches the real cards closely. The highlight on the play button is slightly broad.
Fruit has many small sharp white highlights and water droplets, which makes it glossier than the real cards. Soft shadows and a smooth form turn.
Clean soft shading and a grounded shadow. The light is a bit uniform, and the shadows on the upper tiki-bar parts are shallow.
